brief: Compare cash and instalment prices using their complete payment schedules.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Payment Options"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "¿Contado o cuotas?"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "À vista ou em parcelas?"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare cash and instalment prices using their complete payment schedules.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Small instalments can add up to more than the cash price; compare every payment and when money is needed.
instruction.misconception: A low instalment is the total price, or the cheaper total is automatically affordable today.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Multiply instalment amount by count, then add deposit and fees. Compare that total with cash price and check payment timing.
The instalment plan costs more than the cash price.
One payment does not represent the complete instalment schedule.
Deposit and fee count alongside all instalments.
A lower total does not remove immediate payment constraints.
No stated interest does not remove separate mandatory fees.
The complete instalment schedule exceeds the cash price.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
